summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for Stripe Checkout integration (hosted mode, TEST). All 42 API tests passed (100%). Verified invoice payment checkout, booking deposit checkout (10€), payment status with DB fallback, webhook signature validation, payment_transactions collection structure, Brevo email confirmation function, and security (no client-side amounts). Stripe SDK integration working correctly via emergentintegrations proxy (integrations.emergentagent.com). All 25 existing endpoints still functional (regression passed).
passed_tests: POST /api/payments/checkout/invoice/{id} - creates Stripe session, returns url+session_id, creates payment_transactions entry with kind='invoice_payment'
POST /api/payments/checkout/invoice/{id} - amount computed from invoice.net_total (40.0€), never from client
POST /api/payments/checkout/invoice/{paid_id} - returns 400 'Cette facture est déjà payée.'
POST /api/payments/checkout/invoice/{unknown_id} - returns 404
POST /api/payments/checkout/invoice/{id} without token - returns 401
POST /api/payments/checkout/invoice/{id} without origin_url - returns 422
POST /api/payments/checkout/deposit/{booking_id} - creates session for 10€ (BOOKING_DEPOSIT_EUR config)
POST /api/payments/checkout/deposit/{booking_id} - creates payment_transactions with kind='booking_deposit', amount=10.0
POST /api/payments/checkout/deposit/{cancelled_id} - returns 404 (filters status='confirmed')
GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} - returns JSON with session_id, status, payment_status, kind, source
GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} - DB fallback working when Stripe SDK fails (source='db_fallback')
GET /api/payments/status/{unknown_id} - returns 404
POST /api/webhook/stripe with invalid signature - returns 400
payment_transactions collection verified: 5+ entries with correct structure (session_id, kind, user_id, invoice_id|booking_id, amount, currency='eur', status, payment_status, metadata)
Stripe SDK integration verified: HTTP 200 from integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions
Real test sessions created: cs_test_a12UYjnpJj6NTtuaVLRZZW7YApsnQbVf0y8fbVZinEIHLcLVf4RCxJ3W7p (invoice), cs_test_a1VGL0HP5VMWZecwghttotkbWsJVLp7SUpPPfwOUjmFT5tgZaAZWQIHWqe (deposit)
send_payment_confirmation_email function exists in brevo_email.py (lines 351-415) and is called in _fulfil_paid_session
Security verified: CheckoutInitBody only accepts origin_url, no amount field from client
Invoice amount always from invoice.net_total (payments.py line 176)
Deposit amount always from config.BOOKING_DEPOSIT_EUR=10.0 (payments.py line 224)
Multiple checkout sessions allowed for same unpaid invoice (until marked paid)
Regression: All 25 existing endpoints still working (health, auth, bookings, invoices, contact, admin)
Scheduler verified: APScheduler running with J-1 reminder cron at 18:00 Europe/Paris
